title: Understanding Ridge Regression
text: Ridge regression adds a penalty term to the loss function to prevent overfitting. This penalty term is proportional to the square of the magnitude of the coefficients. Can you think about how increasing this penalty might affect the values of the coefficients?

title: Effect of Increasing Lambda
text: When you increase the regularization parameter lambda, what happens to the penalty term in the ridge regression loss function?
choices: The penalty term stays the same

title: Impact on Coefficients
text: Think about how the increase in the penalty term affects the coefficients. If the penalty term becomes larger, what might happen to the magnitude of the coefficients to minimize the loss function?

hintAnswer: The magnitude of the coefficients decreases
title: Magnitude of Coefficients
text: As the penalty term increases, what happens to the magnitude of the coefficients in ridge regression?
choices: The magnitude of the coefficients increases
The magnitude of the coefficients decreases
The magnitude of the coefficients stays the same
